csv_project_name: Design for Ave A & 36th St HAWK Construction
csv_scope_of_work: City of Yuma maybe seeking design and construct a High-Intensity Activated Crosswalk (HAWK) signal at the intersection of Avenue A and 36th Street in the City of Yuma. The improvement will provide a controlled pedestrian crossing at a key location identified in both the City s Multimodal Transportation Plan and the regional long-range transportation plan. The scope of work includes installation of the HAWK signal, pedestrian push buttons, signage, striping, and associated ADAcompliant curb ramps and accessibility improvements. The project will enhance visibility and control at the crossing, improving safety for pedestrians navigating this corridor.
